fact: The Djanta Tech Hub, funded by the World Bank under the PANT, was officially launched in Lome by the digital transformation ministry, with its two programmes still to be deployed.

African Business says Djanta Tech Hub, a 3,000 square metre campus in central Lome developed by the government with Co-Creation Hub, hosts an incubator, a coding academy, a fabrication laboratory and a programme for female entrepreneurs.
The LuxDev sheet for ProDigiT says the bases of the Djanta Tech Hub have been laid.
